steps.command:
pwd
ls -la /workspace
which openssl python3
openssl version

set -e
mkdir -p /app/ssl
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out /app/ssl/server.key
chmod 600 /app/ssl/server.key
openssl req -new -x509 -key /app/ssl/server.key -out /app/ssl/server.crt -days 365 \
  -subj "/O=DevOps Team/CN=dev-internal.company.local"
cat /app/ssl/server.key /app/ssl/server.crt > /app/ssl/server.pem
chmod 600 /app/ssl/server.pem
chmod 644 /app/ssl/server.crt
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject -dates -fingerprint -sha256
python3 -c "import cryptography; print('cryptography', cryptography.__version__)" 2>/dev/null || echo "no cryptography"

set -e
SUBJ=$(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject -nameopt RFC2253 | sed 's/^subject=//')
NB=$(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -startdate | cut -d= -f2-)
NA=$(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -enddate | cut -d= -f2-)
NB_ISO=$(date -u -d "$NB" +%Y-%m-%d)
NA_ISO=$(date -u -d "$NA" +%Y-%m-%d)
FP=$(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | cut -d= -f2-)
{
  echo "Subject: $SUBJ"
  echo "Not Before: $NB_ISO ($NB)"
  echo "Not After: $NA_ISO ($NA)"
  echo "SHA-256 Fingerprint: $FP"
} > /app/ssl/verification.txt
cat /app/ssl/verification.txt

set -e
chmod 755 /app/check_cert.py
echo "=== check_cert.py ==="
python3 /app/check_cert.py
echo "=== files ==="
ls -l /app/ssl /app/check_cert.py
echo "=== PEM contents ==="
grep -c "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY" /app/ssl/server.pem
grep -c "BEGIN CERTIFICATE" /app/ssl/server.pem
echo "=== key/cert match ==="
[ "$(openssl pkey -in /app/ssl/server.key -pubout 2>/dev/null | sha256sum)" = "$(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -pubkey -noout | sha256sum)" ] && echo "key matches certificate"
echo "=== key size ==="
openssl pkey -in /app/ssl/server.key -text -noout | head -1
